title: The Choir of the Sundered Sea
author: Wendell Marchetti
blurb: Astrid Ravensworth, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
